task: A fund holds 2050 credits. Its first grant is 12% of that original balance. Return 39% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 6% of the original balance minus 6 credits (the 6 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer.

candidate.text: First, calculate the size of the first grant: 12% of 2050 credits is 0.12 * 2050 = 246 credits.  Then, calculate the amount returned: 39% of 246 credits is 0.39 * 246 = 97.94 credits.  Since we can only return whole credits, we'll round to 97.94.  Next, calculate the size of the second grant: 6% of 2050 credits is 0.06 * 2050 = 123 credits.  Subtracting 6 credits gives 123 - 6 = 117 credits.  Then, calculate the amount spent on the second grant: 117 credits.  Finally, calculate the total spending: 246 credits (first grant) + 117 credits (second grant) - 97.94 credits (returned portion) = 246 + 117 - 97.94 = 363 - 97.94 = 265.06 credits.  Therefore, the total spending is 265.06 credits.
